changelog: Adds admin/reseller video management: Stock (shipped) videos can now be deleted, gated behind a simple admin password (session-scoped, not real security - matches this app's existing no-login trust model for its other destructive actions). Import Playlist now also accepts a direct link to a single .mp4 file (no .m3u playlist file needed) and can import straight into Stock instead of My Videos (admin-gated), letting a reseller pre-load the videos a device should ship with.
